E168.description: Due to the change of power in our country, complete lawlessness began in the colonies.
E168.description1: A lot of  fighting in Africa
E168.title: African colonies are furious

E253.description: We have started the total war with Soviet Union. No mercy.
E253.title: The war with Soviet Union

E018.description: Morocco does nor want friendship with Spain. We didn't strive for this, they themselves aspired for this.
E018.title: Operation: "Desert"

E990.description: We took Stockgolm. They can't fight anymore.
E990.title: Sweden is capitulated

E340.description: We have taken their important territory. It's unluckily they will agree to peace anytime soon.
E340.title: Rampage of Turkey

E685.description: We need to decide what do do with land that was once taken from us by the Americans
E685.title: The Texas question
E685.description2: You will continue to hire mercenaries from Texas

E419.description: There is a lot of forests in China. This prevents us from moving deeper.
E419.title: Problems in the forest

E040.description: Revolution happenned, but not to the end. The rivals won't let us develop in peace under communism. We have to reach control of the rest of Chinese territory.
E040.title: Revolution

E282.description: Students and young people are protesting en masse because of our "agressive" politic. They don't want war. Most of them are republic-party supporters.
E282.title: Drowning in protests
E282.answer3: They'll shout and then calm down.

E039.description: Several of our regions have become independent. Civil war has been started.
E039.title: Bad time for the China
E039.answer1: We will fight for our intergrity!

E138.description: We can legalize guns in the country in exchange for internal stability. It could help us in way of a war.
E138.title: Legalization of weapons

E416.description: We can spend some resources to improve the current fleet. This could turn the tide of the war.
E416.description1: He'll spend the money, but he'll give you 15 cruisers.
E416.title: Naval battles
E416.description2: It won't give you 15 cruisers, but you won't spend any money either.

E281.description: Because of our gun legalization law everyone can get a weapon much easier. And often this leads to tragedy.
E281.title: Shooting in the school

E166.description: In London, nationalists staged another rally for us to abandon colonies and occupy the main part of the country.
E166.title: London's riots

E352.description: Italy has almost taken over all of Greece. Athens is on fire. If we claim some disputed Greek territories, then we need to act now. Then we'll be late.
E352.title: Occasion
E352.answer3: We don't apply at all anymore.

E386.description: Despite the fact that only Italy officially fought against Serbs, we need to share the territory we got with our partners.
E386.title: Division of gained lands

E404.description: We took Baghdad. They can't fight anymore.
E404.title: Iraq is capitulated

E033.description: Due to the lack of the universities, the level of military training of the population is declining.
E033.title: Uneducated population

E022.description: We took Budapest. They can't fight anymore.
E022.title: Hungary is capitulated

E165.description: Spain declared an military operation against Morocco due to trading problems.
E165.title: Moroccan war

E157.description: We can introduce a church tax.
E157.title: Church tax

E303.description: We can't land on their island. We need a strong new ally.
E303.title: The UK is fighting back strongly

E769.title: Texas asks for help
E769.answer1: Let it become a new state.

E254.description: Together, we should stop German imperialism!
E254.title: Saving the world from agressor

E164.description: In China, everyone has long forgotten about traditions and faith. But not us!
E164.title: Malaise

E038.description: We took Tehran. They can't fight anynore.
E038.title: Iran is capitulated

E381.description: German Reich called us to take part in the war against the communists.
E381.title: Joining the war

E163.description: We took Shanghai. They can't fight anymore.
E163.title: ROC is capitulated

E080.description: It looks like he has every chance.
E080.title: Kirov won

E178.description: They offered it to us. And it actually makes sense. Should we sign it?
E178.title: Alliance with Soviet Union

E162.description: In honor of our victory in the civil war, the Government of the Uighur Republic decided to return to our membership.
E162.title: Uigur wants to join us

E161.description: We have lost the control of the Minsk.
E161.title: Minsk has fallen

E417.description: Vietnam have lost it's owner France. It means we can start an military operation in there. Germany would have liked it.
E417.title: Operation: "Trees"

E365.description: A fisher from Hungary catched a really rare fish in the Balaton lake.
E365.title: Good catch

E310.description: And in addition, he said that we would be a terrible ally. It was very rude. Perhaps we should take retaliatory measures.
E310.title: The USSR sent us far away
E310.answer2: Okay, let's put up with it.

E709.description: Due to outdated equipment, there was a flood in Salem.
E709.title: Flood in Salem
E709.answer1: There is nothing we can do.

E394.description: China is in enormous disarray right now. This is literally the perfect time to fly in and seize large tracts of land.
E394.title: Perfect Moment

E160.description: We have lost the control of the Kiev.
E160.title: Kiev has fallen

E042.description: Alabama's terrorists robbed a shop and fled across the Russian boder. Maybe Russian government and natives in league?
E042.title: Russia is covering Alabamas

E036.description: With the constructions of farms, you have unlocked the potentional for wealth and agricultural development.
E036.title: Agricultural Development

E159.description: The news has reached us that we have successfully disabled several enemy tanks! But you can always improve the result. Field mechanics say that tanks can still be repaired. Imagine if you sent enemy tanks at their own troops? That's all you need money for...
E159.title: Breach

E158.description: Indian leader was flatted by our operation in Iraq, so he decided to give up his country's management rights to us.
E158.title: Respect from Indian ruler

E356.description: There has been a coup, and we are here, to fix that.
E356.title: War inside Confederation

E279.description: A lot of huge-importance countries already joint Vector military alliance, but we are still not one of them. Is that good condition?
E279.title: Log in to the game

E376.description: We saved some nations from extinct after this war.
E376.title: Liberation of Yougoslavia

E067.description: Not a fact that we would win this war. Maybe we need stop this before its too late?
E067.description1: Send a peace proposal to AC
E067.title: Treaty of San-Antonio
E067.description2: Do not send a peace proposal to AC
E067.answer2: No, it's all under my control.

E407.description: Almost all Europe is under German control now.
E407.title: Last days of Europe
